Listen to a dialogue at a pet shop
Find out which animal the girl chose
Спершу просто послухай. Потім прочитай п: First, just listen. Then read the questions and listen again.
Послухаємо, як друзі домовляються про ви:
Listen to friends making weekend plans
Remember: Present Continuous for plans
Про домовлені плани говоримо Present Con: We use Present Continuous for arranged plans: **I’m meeting** friends on Saturday. **We’re going** to the cinema at four.
Put the verbs in brackets into the correct form.
Потренуємо аудіювання у форматі НМТ\nНав:
Practise listening in the NMT format
Learn to catch numbers, times and details
Лайфхак НМТ: перед прослуховуванням проч: NMT tip: before listening, read the questions and underline exactly what you need to hear (time, place, number). Often all the options are mentioned, and the correct one is the one left after the speakers clarify.

заселитися: to arrive and register at a hotel
включено: part of the price, no extra cost
пароль від Wi-Fi: the code to connect to Wi-Fi
виселитися: to pay and leave a hotel
